name: referenceWingArea
description: Reference area of brick aero model (assumed area is 8" by 4")

name: referenceWingSpan
description: Width of brick model (4"), used as reference lateral length

name: referenceWingChord
description: Length of brick model (8"), used as reference longitudinal length

name: roll damping from roll rate
description: Constant fake roll damping due to roll rate of brick test vehicle

name: roll damping from yaw rate
description: Constant fake roll damping due to yaw rate of brick test vehicle

name: pitch damping from pitch rate
description: Constant fake pitch damping of brick test vehicle

name: yaw damping from roll rate
description: Constant fake yaw damping due to roll rate of brick test vehicle

name: yaw damping from yaw rate
description: Constant fake yaw damping due to yaw rate of brick test vehicle

name: trueAirspeed
description: Velocity of vehicle w.r.t. airmass, ft/sec (always +)

name: bodyAngularRate_Roll
description: Body-axis roll rate, radians/sec (+right wing down)

name: bodyAngularRate_Pitch
description: Body-axis pitch rate, radians/sec (+aircraft nose up)

name: bodyAngularRate_Yaw
description: Body-axis yaw rate, radians/sec (+aircraft nose right)

name: PBO2V
description: Non-dimensionalized body roll rate w.r.t. airmass

name: QCO2V
description: Non-dimensionalized body pitch rate w.r.t. airmass

name: RBO2V
description: Non-dimensionalized body yaw rate w.r.t. airmass

name: totalCoefficientOfLift
description: Coefficient of Lift

name: totalCoefficientOfDrag
description: Fake coefficient of drag for a standard brick

name: aeroBodyForceCoefficient_Y
description: Coefficient of Sideforce

description: Cl = Clp*pb/2V + Clr*rb/2V

name: aeroBodyMomentCoefficient_Pitch
